2025-07-14.riddle: I open locks but not with teeth, I twist in holes and turn beneath. I’m often kept on heavy rings— What am I?

2025-07-15.riddle: I flip and fly, I make a breeze, I’m found in rooms with quiet ease. Hung from ceilings, spinning round— What am I?
2025-07-15.hint: I cool you down without a chill.

2025-07-16.riddle: I shine at night from poles so tall, I light the street for one and all. I glow through fog and evening rain— What am I?
2025-07-16.hint: I guide your path when it’s too dark to see.

2025-07-17.riddle: I wear no shoes, yet never rest, I beat and thump inside your chest. I race with joy and slow with sleep— What am I?
2025-07-17.hint: I never stop while you're alive.

2025-07-18.riddle: I have four legs but do not walk, I stand in rooms and never talk. I hold your meals or maybe books— What am I?
2025-07-18.hint: I support everything from dinner to homework.

2025-07-19.riddle: I open wide to let you in, I close you out with just a spin. With knobs and locks, I stand in place— What am I?
2025-07-19.hint: I stand between in and out.

2025-07-20.riddle: I send your voice across the air, I keep you talking from anywhere. I ring and buzz inside your hand— What am I?
2025-07-20.hint: You probably check me too often.

2025-07-21.riddle: I climb with rungs, I never bend, I help you reach where arms won’t extend. Just lean me right and up you go— What am I?
2025-07-21.hint: I take you higher without stairs.
